basic.name: Field Sign
basic.description: Deals 250% Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP and applies Quarry for 2 rounds. Quarry makes Hale's attacks against that enemy hit 10% harder. Pinoy writes the damage as 120% and Quarry as ignoring 10% Defense; the percentage is the star band's and the engine has no per-attacker armour ignore, so Quarry is a source-keyed Vulnerable of the same size. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/PINOY-LIST.md section 2d.

active.name: Closing Radius
active.description: Deals 570% Attack damage to the enemy with Quarry. If any ally attacked it since Hale's last turn, deals additional damage equal to 12% of its missing HP, up to 120% of Attack. Pinoy writes the first number as 220%; the percentage is the star band's. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/PINOY-LIST.md section 2d.

passive.name: Tracking Habit
passive.description: Hale fights the whole battle with Attack Up and Focus.

passive1.name: Tracking Habit
passive1.description: At the end of each round, if Quarry still stands, it moves to the enemy that dealt the most damage that round, and Hale hits it harder.

passive2.name: No Safe Distance
passive2.description: When an enemy marked as Quarry gains a Ward, Hale strikes it and Quarry comes off. Once per enemy.

passive2.name: No Safe Distance (unseen)
passive2.description: When an enemy marked as Quarry becomes Untargetable, Hale strikes it and Quarry comes off. Once per enemy.

talentI.name: Fresh Trail
talentI.description: At the start of each of his turns, Hale gains Crit Damage Up.

talentII.name: Cornered
talentII.description: Closing Radius’s missing-HP blow also lands while Hale is at low HP, even if no ally has struck Quarry.

talentIII.name: Pursuit Continues
talentIII.description: When an enemy marked as Quarry is defeated, Hale marks the lowest-HP enemy as Quarry, and Hale hits it harder.

basic.name: Breach Inspection
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Fault Line.

active.name: Take Down the Wall
active.description: Strikes every enemy and strips a buff from each enemy with Fault Line. Kael gains Rubble, up to a limit.

passive.name: Unusable Cover
passive.description: Kael fights the whole battle with Guard Up and Block Up.

passive1.name: Unusable Cover
passive1.description: Once per round, when an ally holding a Ward ends their turn while Kael holds Rubble, Kael spends a Rubble to take a share of that Ward, then passes all of Kael’s Ward to the lowest-HP ally.

passive2.name: What Breaks Forward
passive2.description: After Kael’s basic attack, Kael spends all Rubble. The attack deals additional damage for each Rubble spent, and the lowest-HP ally gains a Ward worth a share of Kael’s Max HP for each.

talentI.name: Measured Demolition
talentI.description: After Kael's basic attack the fault he opened widens: an enemy with Fault Line is easier to affect, and his own blows land harder on it.

talentII.name: Clear the Debris
talentII.description: Take Down the Wall applies Fault Line to every enemy it stripped a buff from, and leaves each of them open to Kael.

talentIII.name: Salvaged Materials
talentIII.description: Kael salvages a piece of Rubble from every blow he lands, and can hold more of it than before.

basic.name: Cut the Escort
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the lowest HP and applies Forsaken.

active.name: Sever the Return
active.description: Strikes a Forsaken enemy. If it gained a Ward or was healed since Kiva’s last turn, she strips its Ward and deals additional damage from its missing HP, up to a limit. If Kiva holds a Broken Link, she spends it to apply Heal Suppression, or to take Energy off an enemy that already cannot be healed.

passive.name: Abandoned Support
passive.description: Kiva fights the whole battle with Attack Up, Quickened and Focus.

passive1.name: Abandoned Support
passive1.description: The first time each round a Forsaken enemy gains a buff, Kiva gains a Broken Link, holding up to a limit.

passive2.name: Severance Paid
passive2.description: After Kiva’s basic attack against a Forsaken enemy, she spends a Broken Link to apply Heal Suppression. If that enemy cannot be healed, it also loses Energy. Each enemy once per round.

talentI.name: No Safe Escort
talentI.description: Cut the Escort strips its target's Block and leaves it open, so every blow Kiva lands on it afterwards hits harder.

talentII.name: Cut the Last Line
talentII.description: When an enemy is brought low, Kiva names the largest body still standing Forsaken, and the whole line's guard breaks with the one that is failing.

talentIII.name: Unclaimed Victory
talentIII.description: When an enemy falls, Kiva takes a Ward worth a share of her Max HP. If she is holding a Broken Link, the Ward is larger and every Broken Link she holds is spent.

basic.name: Witnessed Strike
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally. If that ally took damage since Marrow’s last turn, it also gains Promise, and Marrow takes a share of the damage it takes.

active.name: Vow Kept
active.description: Strikes every enemy and gives the two lowest-HP allies Promise. While Promise lasts, Marrow takes a share of the damage they take.

passive.name: The Cost Is Named
passive.description: Marrow fights the whole battle with Max HP Up and Effect Resist Up.

passive1.name: The Cost Is Named
passive1.description: When an ally holding Promise starts their next turn, Promise is spent: it heals them for a share of their Max HP and removes a debuff.

passive2.name: Promise Survives
passive2.description: The first time an ally holding Promise would be defeated, Promise is spent, the ally is left barely standing and Marrow takes the rest of the blow. Marrow then briefly cannot be healed. Once per battle.

passive1.name: The Cost Is Named (self)
passive1.description: When Marrow himself holds Promise, it is spent at the start of his next turn: it heals him for a share of his Max HP and removes a debuff.

talentI.name: Shared Oath
talentI.description: Vow Kept gives Promise to the three lowest-HP allies instead of two, and the Promise heal is larger for all of them.

talentII.name: Visible Cost
talentII.description: When Marrow takes damage on an ally's behalf the attacker loses Energy, and the vow closes part of the wound it cost him.

talentIII.name: No Withdrawal
talentIII.description: Whenever an ally is about to fall, Marrow strikes the enemy nearest to falling himself and mends the ally closest to going with them.

basic.name: Marginal Note
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Footnote. Footnote records a share of the first damage the enemy takes each round, up to a limit.

active.name: Contradiction Filed
active.description: Strikes every enemy. Each enemy with Footnote takes damage equal to its record and loses Footnote, then Footnote is written onto the enemy with the highest Energy.

passive.name: Contrary Evidence
passive.description: Seraphine fights the whole battle with Attack Up, Effect Hit Up and Skill Damage Up.

passive1.name: Contrary Evidence
passive1.description: When an enemy with Footnote gains a buff, Seraphine strips a buff from it and adds to its record.

passive2.name: Volume Closed
passive2.description: When a Footnote record reaches its cap, the target cannot gain buffs for 1 round, loses turn progress, has Footnote removed and takes damage equal to the whole record, and Seraphine gains 15 Energy. Pinoy writes it in two beats, with the removal and the Energy arriving when the restriction ends, and says nothing about the record being paid out. Both departures are the same repair: the second beat was gated on a Mark that Contrary Evidence - Seraphine's own Dispel - strips on the same trigger that fills the record, so it could never run, and a record that reached its cap was thrown away unread. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/PINOY-LIST.md section 2d.

talentI.name: Second Reading
talentI.description: Footnote records a larger share of the damage, whether Marginal Note or Contradiction Filed wrote it.

talentII.name: Cross Reference
talentII.description: The Footnote that Contradiction Filed writes onto the highest-Energy enemy starts with a record already in it.

talentIII.name: No Revision
talentIII.description: When Volume Closed fires, the enemy loses turn progress and the record it pays out lands far harder.

basic.name: Faultline Tap
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Cracked. Cracked reduces its Block.

active.name: Demolition Right
active.description: Strikes the front enemy. If it is Cracked, removes Cracked and grants Branik a Ward worth a share of his Max HP.

passive1.name: Salvaged Cover
passive1.description: The first time each round a Cracked enemy attacks, Branik gains Bulwark until round end.

basic.name: Notice of Loss
basic.description: Deals 180% Attack damage and applies Arrears for 2 rounds. At turn end, Arrears loses 4% of its current HP, bounded at 105% of Demos's Attack. The bound is not in Pinoy's sentence and is the only thing holding the clause inside the star band; it is enforced on the Notice of Loss tick passive - see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 12.

active.name: Compounding Sentence
active.description: Strikes every enemy with Arrears and extends Arrears, up to a limit.

passive1.name: No Appeal
passive1.description: Enemies with Arrears receive less healing; on defeat, their Arrears moves to the highest-HP enemy.

passives.name: Notice of Loss
passives.description: The Arrears tick: a body carrying it loses 4% of its current HP as its own turn ends, bounded at 105% of Demos's Attack. The bound is not in Pinoy's sentence and is the only thing holding the clause inside the band - see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 12.

basic.name: Commitment Cut
basic.description: Strikes Kest’s last target. If he attacked it last turn, deals additional damage.

active.name: No Way Back
active.description: Strikes Kest’s last target. On defeat, attacks the lowest-HP enemy.

passive1.name: Commit to the Return
passive1.description: Kest cannot change targets while his target lives, but deals more damage to it and takes less from it.

passives.name: No Way Back
passives.description: The follow-through on No Way Back only: an enemy defeated during that cast carries into the lowest-HP enemy.

basic.name: Measured Tap
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally.

active.name: Hard Remedy
active.description: Strikes every enemy, removes a debuff from each ally, and cleansed allies recover a share of their missing HP.

passive1.name: Triage After Loss
passive1.description: The first time an ally falls to low HP, grant them a Ward worth a share of their Max HP.

basic.name: Rangefinder Bolt
basic.description: Strikes the highest-Attack enemy and applies Exposed Frequency. Allied attacks ignore some of its Defense.

active.name: Cut the Wire
active.description: Strikes an enemy with Exposed Frequency, then transfers its buffs to the lowest-HP enemy.

passive1.name: Dead Channel
passive1.description: When an enemy with Exposed Frequency gains a buff, Tavia strikes it, once per round.

basic.name: Mapcase Bash
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Lost Route. Lost Route reduces its Accuracy.

active.name: Erase the Road
active.description: Strikes every enemy with Lost Route and grants Adric a Ward worth a share of his Max HP.

passive1.name: No Return Mark
passive1.description: When an attack from an enemy carrying Lost Route misses Adric, he gains 8 Energy. Pinoy writes it as any miss by a Lost Route enemy; the engine raises its miss window on the body that dodged, so only Adric dodging reaches him. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 24.

basic.name: Scoring Point
basic.description: Deals 350% Attack damage to the highest-Attack enemy and applies Fracture for 2 rounds. A Fractured body takes 15% more damage. Pinoy writes the bonus onto the next critical hit only; the engine has no crit-scoped damage modifier and no per-hit charge on one, so it answers every blow for the duration. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 23.

active.name: Shatterproof
active.description: Strikes an enemy with Fracture and spreads Fracture to the enemies beside it.

passive1.name: Stress Line
passive1.description: When an enemy with Fracture is defeated, all remaining enemies lose Energy.

basic.name: Stamped Parcel
basic.description: Deals 258% Attack damage and applies Delivered for 2 rounds. Delivered targets take 8% more damage from active skills. Pinoy writes it as the next active skill only; the engine has no per-hit charge on a damage modifier, so it holds for the duration. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 23.

active.name: Return to Sender
active.description: Deals 454% Attack damage to all Delivered enemies and takes Delivered back off them, giving Quin 12 Energy. Pinoy pays the 12 per target; nothing in the engine scales an amount by how many bodies an effect reached, so it pays once. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 25.

passive1.name: Urgent Matter
passive1.description: Quin opens the battle with 15 Energy already banked. Pinoy writes it as his first active skill costing 15 less; an ability cost can only be moved by a talent override, which a 3-star does not carry. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 26.

basic.name: Filed Objection
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Overdue. Overdue reduces the healing it receives.

active.name: Deadline
active.description: Strikes an Overdue enemy. If it is at low HP, deals additional damage.

passive1.name: No Extension
passive1.description: At round start Overdue is written back onto the enemy carrying it, so it cannot be shaken off. Pinoy writes it as Overdue being uncleansable during the round it was applied; the engine has no cleanse immunity, and a renewal is the nearest thing it can say. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 27.

basic.name: Chisel Strike
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy, and hits it again if its Ward is still standing.

passive1.name: Rubble Resolve
passive1.description: When Arno strikes an enemy carrying a Shield, he gains 8% Attack for 2 rounds. Pinoy writes it as the moment an enemy Shield is removed; a break is raised on the body that lost the Shield and on that body's own side, so the unit that broke it never hears about it. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 32.

basic.name: Splintering Blow
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives Barr Bulwark.

passive1.name: Give Way
passive1.description: The first time Barr falls to low HP, he gains a Ward worth a share of his Max HP.

basic.name: Price Breaker
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and takes some Energy off it.

passive1.name: Cheap Kindling
passive1.description: When Piri defeats an enemy, the ally with the emptiest bar gains Energy.

basic.name: Cargo Spark
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the lowest HP.

basic.name: Signpost Strike
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy.

basic.name: Shared Pain
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally. While Nereia is near full health, she also heals them for a share of her Max HP. At full Flow, she heals that ally again and spends all her Flow.

active.name: Relief Circuit
active.description: Strikes every enemy and heals the two lowest-HP allies, who become Covered: a share of the damage they take goes to Nereia instead. Nereia banks part of the damage she takes as Reserve, up to a limit, and when Reserve ends it heals the lowest-HP ally.

passive.name: Triage Buffer
passive.description: Nereia fights the whole battle with Max HP Up and Effect Resist Up.

passive1.name: Triage Buffer
passive1.description: When damage is redirected onto Nereia, she gains Flow, up to a limit.

passive2.name: Change of Course
passive2.description: The first time each round an ally Covered by Relief Circuit would fall, Nereia takes the killing blow's excess herself, leaves them standing and heals them for a share of their Max HP.

talentI.name: Deeper Reservoir
talentI.description: Relief Circuit's Reserve can hold more, and when Reserve pays out healing, Nereia gains Energy.

talentII.name: Shared Reserve
talentII.description: When Reserve pays out, the lowest-HP ally also gains a Ward worth a share of what it held.

talentIII.name: Reversed Flow
talentIII.description: Whenever damage is turned onto Nereia she sends part of it back at the enemy with the highest Attack, and far more of it when Change of Course catches an ally outright.

passive1.name: Triage Buffer (heal)
passive1.description: When Nereia heals an ally at low HP, she gains Flow, up to a limit.

basic.name: Revision Script
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest Attack. If it has Attack Up, Rheia applies Guard Down and strips the Attack Up.

active.name: Rewrite the Outcome
active.description: Strikes every enemy and applies Guard Down. Any enemy with Attack Down has it rewritten: it gains Attack Up, takes an extra hit and loses the Attack Down.

passive.name: Applied Revision
passive.description: Rheia fights the whole battle with Attack Up, Effect Hit Up and Skill Damage Up. Each Revision she holds also raises her Speed.

passive1.name: Applied Revision
passive1.description: When an enemy gains a buff from Rheia, she gains Revision, up to a limit, and gains Energy. This pays out only so often each round.

passive2.name: Second Draft
passive2.description: Once per enemy each round, when an enemy with Guard Down gains a buff from Rheia, she strikes it and gains Energy. At full Revision she strikes it again, harder, and spends all her Revision.

talentI.name: Endless Revision
talentI.description: Rewrite the Outcome's blow on an enemy whose Attack Down it rewrote lands far harder.

talentII.name: Counterrevision
talentII.description: When Second Draft fires at full Revision the target is left open to Rheia, gains Attack Down if it holds Attack Up, and Rheia gains Guard Up.

talentIII.name: Perfect Reversal
talentIII.description: Second Draft's full-Revision strike lands harder and no longer spends the Revision it was built on.

basic.name: Deflection Strike
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Deflected.

active.name: Pass the Guard
active.description: Strikes every enemy, moves Rovan's Ward to the lowest-HP ally and makes them Covered: a share of the damage they take goes to Rovan instead.

passive.name: Adaptive Guard
passive.description: Rovan fights the whole battle with Max HP Up, Guard Up and Block Up.

passive1.name: Deflection Strike (Deflected)
passive1.description: The first time each round a Deflected enemy damages one of Rovan's allies, Rovan gains a Ward worth a share of the damage dealt.

passive2.name: Adaptive Guard
passive2.description: Once per round, when Rovan takes redirected damage for an ally, he moves a debuff from that ally onto himself.

passive1.name: Return the Guard
passive1.description: When Covered expires on an ally, Rovan takes back their remaining Ward. If the Ward he takes back is large, he strikes every Deflected enemy.

passive2.name: Return the Guard (defeat)
passive2.description: When a Covered ally falls, Rovan takes their remaining Ward. If it is large, he strikes every Deflected enemy.

talentI.name: Shared Angle
talentI.description: Pass the Guard gives the ally it covers Effect Resist Up and a second Ward of its own, worth a share of Rovan's Max HP.

talentII.name: No Wasted Guard
talentII.description: When Pass the Guard moves a large Ward, the ally who receives it gains Energy, more Energy if the Ward was larger still, and Rovan keeps a share of the guard he gave away.

talentIII.name: Guard in Motion
talentIII.description: When Covered expires on an ally, Rovan also gives the second-lowest-HP ally a Ward worth a share of his Max HP.

basic.name: Redirecting Shot
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest Attack, then repeats part of that damage against the lowest-HP enemy if Talren has not hit it this round. Striking a new target gains him Route and Crit Damage Up, up to a limit.

active.name: Change the Course
active.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest Attack and the enemy with the lowest HP, and records both.

passive.name: Adaptive Path
passive.description: Talren fights the whole battle with Attack Up, Quickened and Focus.

passive1.name: Where the Arrow Lands
passive1.description: When Redirecting Shot's repeated damage lands, Talren gains Energy and heals himself. If the enemy it landed on is at low HP, he strikes it again.

passive2.name: Change the Course (record)
passive2.description: When Talren hits a recorded target, the other recorded target is struck too, harder if it is at low HP, and Talren gains Energy and heals himself.

talentI.name: Open Route
talentI.description: Redirecting Shot needs less Route behind it to break open, and when it does it deals a great deal more damage and spends all the Route it took to get there.

talentII.name: Dual Record
talentII.description: Change the Course also records the enemy with the highest HP.

talentIII.name: Final Path
talentIII.description: Each time a recorded target is struck, Talren looses an arrow at every enemy he has recorded, and a second at any of them near the end.

basic.name: Leaving Cut
basic.description: Strikes the lowest-HP enemy and applies Departure to the enemy Vaelis struck before it. His next attack on a new target spends any bonus an ally banked: a Bulwark or Vanguard gives Armor Break Up, a Mender or Warden heals him, and a Striker, Breaker, Stalker or Marksman adds damage.

active.name: Passed Position
active.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest Attack and the enemy with the lowest HP. If either carries Departure, its buffs move to the other.

passive.name: Never Still
passive.description: Vaelis fights the whole battle with Quickened, Focus and Crit Damage Up.

passive1.name: Departure
passive1.description: When an ally hits an enemy carrying Departure, Vaelis strikes his last target and banks a bonus for his next basic attack based on that ally's role.

passive2.name: Opening Moves
passive2.description: Once per round, when an enemy is defeated while Vaelis is bound by Departure, Departure passes to the highest-HP enemy and his next turn advances.

talentI.name: False Exit
talentI.description: Leaving Cut lowers the Departure target's Effect Resist until an ally's strike sets Departure off, and the cut Vaelis answers with lands far harder.

talentII.name: Stolen Position
talentII.description: Passed Position leaves both bodies it moves between open to Vaelis before it strikes either of them.

talentIII.name: No Place to Hold
talentIII.description: When a Mender or Warden sets off Departure, Vaelis also gains Energy.

basic.name: Offered Strike
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives the lowest-Energy ally Energy.

active.name: Distribution
active.description: Strikes every enemy, then transfers the largest ally Ward to the lowest-HP ally and extends it.

passive1.name: Nothing Hoarded
passive1.description: At round start, Celen transfers Energy from the highest-Energy ally to the lowest.

basic.name: Reclaimed Round
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Loose Parts. The next ally to hit it gains Energy.

active.name: Parts Exchange
active.description: Strikes every enemy with Loose Parts, then moves Loose Parts to the highest-HP enemy.

passive1.name: Find a Use
passive1.description: When an ally gains Energy from Loose Parts, Mika gains a Ward.

passives.name: Reclaimed Round
passives.description: The Loose Parts payout itself: the first ally each round to strike a marked enemy takes Energy off it.

basic.name: Crossing Cut
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives the lowest-HP ally a share of the HP they are missing, out of Rhys’s own, if they are badly hurt.

active.name: Change Sides
active.description: Strikes the front enemy and swaps Rhys’s buffs with the target’s debuffs.

passive1.name: Shared Peril
passive1.description: When an ally takes a heavy hit, Rhys takes a share of it instead, once per round.

basic.name: Bad Omen
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and changes a buff on it into its matching debuff.

active.name: Forecast Reversed
active.description: Strikes every enemy and reverses an Attack, Defense or Speed modifier on each.

passive1.name: Prediction Cost
passive1.description: Whenever Siofra changes a buff into a debuff, that target loses Energy, once per round.

passives.name: Prediction Cost
passives.description: The same cost after Forecast Reversed: every enemy whose modifier was turned over loses Energy.

basic.name: Wrong Turn
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Misdirected. The first buff a Misdirected enemy gains each round goes to one of Vanno’s allies instead.

active.name: Road Not Taken
active.description: Strikes a Misdirected enemy and moves its debuffs to the highest-HP enemy.

passive1.name: Exit Unmarked
passive1.description: When a Misdirected enemy falls, Vanno cannot be targeted until his next turn.

passives.name: Wrong Turn
passives.description: The misdirection itself: a buff landing on a Misdirected enemy is taken off it and given to a random ally of Vanno’s, once per round.

basic.name: Shared Passage
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives the lowest-HP ally Bulwark.

active.name: Take Another Route
active.description: Deals 380% Attack damage to the highest-HP enemy. Pinoy swaps the target’s present HP percentage with that body’s; the engine has no two-way exchange and no one-way transfer between two units that are not the caster, so the blow is routed to the big body instead. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 11.

passive1.name: Reserved Passage
passive1.description: The first time an ally falls to low HP, Bren advances their turn.

basic.name: Ricochet Mark
basic.description: Deals 251% Attack damage to the highest-Attack enemy and applies Offset for 2 rounds, then a 57% Attack ricochet strikes that enemy again and the enemies beside it. Pinoy hangs the ricochet on the next ALLY attack against an Offset body; that shape needs a link and a second passive, which a 3-star does not carry, so Cal’s own shot carries it. Draft, Pinoy to confirm.

active.name: Corner Shot
active.description: Strikes an Offset enemy, and the same blow strikes both enemies beside it.

passive1.name: New Sightline
passive1.description: When Cal defeats an Offset enemy, his next attack is a guaranteed Critical Hit. Pinoy names the splash as the killer; the engine does not record which effect of a cast landed the blow. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 28.

basic.name: Wrong Number
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Crossed Line.

active.name: Operator Error
active.description: Strikes every enemy with Crossed Line and delays each of them.

passive1.name: Open Circuit
passive1.description: At round start, one debuff on the Crossed Line enemy is reconnected to a random enemy for 2 rounds and Linnet gains 10 Energy. Pinoy has Crossed Line reroute the first debuff to LAND on that body each round; the engine has no window for a debuff arriving on an enemy, so the reroute is done at round start on whatever is already there, and the 10 Energy pays whether or not anything moved. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md groups 29 and 30.

basic.name: Corrective Cut
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and heals the ally with the most debuffs.

active.name: Reposition the Hurt
active.description: Strikes every enemy, then moves a debuff from each ally onto the highest-HP enemy.

passive1.name: Useful Scar
passive1.description: After Reposition the Hurt, every ally gains 8% Defense for 2 rounds. Pinoy pays only the allies who actually lost a debuff to Oswin; the engine records a removal for a cleanse, a dispel and a named strip but not for a move, so the condition that would ask has nothing to read. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 30.

basic.name: Unmoored Swing
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and advances Dett's next turn.

passive1.name: Turn With It
passive1.description: When an active skill is aimed at Dett, he gains Bulwark.

basic.name: Cargo Bolt
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy, takes some Energy off it and gives Energy to the ally with the emptiest bar.

passive1.name: Counterweight
passive1.description: An ally Hod hands Energy to gains Guard Up.

basic.name: Deflection Shot
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives the lowest-HP ally Quickened.

passive1.name: Second Bearing
passive1.description: Yara never aims twice running at the same enemy, and gains 10% Attack for 1 round each time she takes a new bearing. Pinoy writes it as a reward for changing target and pays it in Energy; nothing lets a hero hear its own target change, and a 2-star has no active skill to spend Energy on, so the switch is made a standing rule and the reward is paid in Attack. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 33.

basic.name: Side Shot
basic.description: Strikes a random enemy.

basic.name: Wheelhouse Swing
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives Energy to the ally with the emptiest bar.

basic.name: Stubborn Blow
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives Brenna Lasting Guard. Lasting Guard reduces the next hit she takes and records the damage it prevented as Memory, which heals her when it expires.

active.name: Stand Again
active.description: Strikes every enemy and gives all allies Lasting Guard. Each ally records the damage their Guard prevents as Memory, up to a limit, and heals for that Memory when it expires.

passive.name: Deep Resolve
passive.description: Brenna fights the whole battle with Max HP Up, Guard Up and Block Up.

passive1.name: Deep Resolve
passive1.description: The first time each round an ally's Memory records prevented damage, the lowest-HP ally gains a Ward worth a share of what was recorded.

passive2.name: Survival of the Stubborn
passive2.description: The first time an ally holding Lasting Guard would be defeated, they are left barely standing and Brenna takes the overflow herself. Their Guard and Memory are consumed, and the damage she took is added to her own Memory.

talentI.name: Memory of Every Blow
talentI.description: Brenna's own Lasting Guard turns away far more of the blow it meets, and the Memory Stand Again writes on the line can hold more before it reaches its limit.

talentII.name: Shared Wall
talentII.description: The Ward Deep Resolve grants is far larger, and the lowest-HP ally also gains Guard against the next hit they take.

talentIII.name: What Held Once
talentIII.description: Stand Again puts a Ward of Brenna's own Max HP on every ally, and a far larger one once Survival of the Stubborn has already caught someone.

basic.name: Mark of Survival
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the lowest HP and applies Observed Mark. Each further strike deepens the Mark, up to a limit.

active.name: The Old Watchtower
active.description: Strikes every enemy, then strikes the enemy with the deepest Observed Mark again and turns its Mark into a Watcher's Ledger. The Ledger records a share of the damage that enemy takes, up to a limit; when it expires, it deals the stored damage to it and heals Edrin for part of it.

passive.name: Guardian of What Remains
passive.description: Edrin fights the whole battle with Attack Up, Quickened and Focus.

passive1.name: Guardian of What Remains
passive1.description: After Edrin's basic attack strikes an enemy with his Observed Mark, he gains Resolve, up to a limit. Each Resolve makes his damage against marked enemies stronger.

passive2.name: Still Here
passive2.description: Once per round, when an ally falls to low HP, Edrin strikes the enemy with the deepest Observed Mark and gives the lowest-HP ally a Ward worth a share of his Max HP. If that enemy's Mark is at full depth, Edrin gains Energy.

talentI.name: Kept Watch
talentI.description: Observed Mark lasts longer and can be driven deeper, and every blow Mark of Survival lands leaves the enemy it struck open to Edrin.

talentII.name: Watchfires
talentII.description: The Old Watchtower also gives the lowest-HP ally a Ward worth a share of Edrin's Max HP.

talentIII.name: Nothing Is Lost
talentIII.description: Edrin banks Resolve far past where he used to stop, and every one of them keeps making his blows against a marked enemy land harder.

basic.name: Patient Measure
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest Attack and applies Mire. If it was already in Mire, Elyra heals the lowest-HP ally.

active.name: Sanctuary Unbroken
active.description: Strikes every enemy and applies Mire to all of them. The enemy with the highest Attack also gains Provoke.

passive.name: Slow Growth
passive.description: Elyra fights the whole battle with Attack Up, Effect Hit Up and Skill Damage Up, and each Resolve she holds makes her healing stronger.

passive1.name: Slow Growth
passive1.description: After Elyra's basic attack, if its target was already in Mire when she struck it, she gains Resolve, up to a limit.

passive2.name: Stillness Pays
passive2.description: When a Provoke Elyra applied expires, she strikes that enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally. She then spends all her Resolve: each one adds another blow, the more she spends the more she heals, and full Resolve also gives her Energy.

talentI.name: Deep Rest
talentI.description: Mire from Patient Measure and Sanctuary Unbroken lasts longer, and whenever a Mire Elyra set fades she mends the ally with the lowest HP.

talentII.name: Sanctuary Spreads
talentII.description: Sanctuary Unbroken also applies Mire to the enemy with the lowest HP and strikes it again.

talentIII.name: Calculated Patience
talentIII.description: When Stillness Pays spends full Resolve, its last blow lands much harder and the lowest-HP ally gains a Ward worth a share of Elyra's Max HP.

basic.name: Restoring Touch
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally, more if they are at low HP. With full Resolve, Isara spends it all to heal that ally again.

active.name: Return After Loss
active.description: Strikes every enemy, heals all allies and gives the two lowest-HP allies a Seedling.

passive.name: Persistent Life
passive.description: Isara fights the whole battle with Max HP Up, Effect Resist Up and Guard Up.

passive1.name: Persistent Life
passive1.description: Whenever Isara heals a badly hurt ally, she gains Resolve, up to a limit.

passive2.name: What Survives
passive2.description: When an ally carrying Isara's Seedling falls to very low HP, the Seedling is consumed: the ally recovers a share of their Max HP and gains a Ward worth a share of Isara's Max HP, Isara gains Energy, and the lowest-HP ally is healed.

talentI.name: Deeper Resolve
talentI.description: Seedlings last longer, and the Ward a Seedling grants is larger.

talentII.name: Shared Recovery
talentII.description: When a Seedling is consumed, the lowest-HP ally is healed once more.

talentIII.name: Second Chance
talentIII.description: The first time an ally would be defeated, if they carry a Seedling, they are left barely standing and Isara takes the overflow herself. The Seedling is then consumed with its full effect.

basic.name: Open Wound
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Cinder, which remembers the last buff that enemy gained.

active.name: Collect the Wound
active.description: Strikes the enemy with the most Cinder still to burn, removes its Cinder and stores what it would have dealt in a Scar Record that also remembers its last buff. When the Scar Record expires, it deals the stored damage to that enemy, up to a limit.

passive.name: Persistent Edge
passive.description: Sylven fights the whole battle with Attack Up, Quickened and Focus.

passive1.name: Persistent Edge
passive1.description: When an enemy is defeated, its Scar Record and Cinder move to the highest-HP enemy. Moved Cinder burns harder but cannot be extended.

passive2.name: Wounds Remember
passive2.description: When an enemy with a Scar Record gains the buff it remembers, Sylven strips that buff, removes the Scar Record and strikes it. Any other buff it gains becomes the one the Record remembers.

talentI.name: Lasting Evidence
talentI.description: The Scar Record lasts longer, and the body that carries it stays open to Sylven's blade while it does.

talentII.name: Inherited Injury
talentII.description: When an enemy is defeated the highest-HP enemy loses Energy, and every enemy still standing carries the wound: Sylven's blows land harder on all of them.

talentIII.name: Nothing Heals Cleanly
talentIII.description: When Wounds Remember answers the buff it was waiting for, the enemy's mending is shut down and the wound reopens: Sylven cuts it deeper from then on.

basic.name: Measurement Strike
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Settling. Settling reduces Speed further each round, up to a limit.

active.name: Weight of Time
active.description: Settles every enemy with Settling one step deeper, then strikes them. Targets whose Settling reaches its limit are Stunned.

passive1.name: Load Bearing
passive1.description: When Settling expires, apply Guard Down.

basic.name: Reserve Swing
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and grants Halwen Reserve. Reserve reduces the next damage taken.

active.name: Open the Reserve
active.description: Strikes every enemy and grants Reserve to all allies.

passive1.name: Rationed Strength
passive1.description: When Reserve prevents damage, its holder recovers a share of their Max HP, or gains Energy if already whole.

basic.name: Holdfast Thrust
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy. If Jory was attacked since his last turn, he heals a share of his Max HP.

active.name: Bar the Way
active.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Provoke to it; it deals less damage to Jory.

passive1.name: Worn Hinges
passive1.description: The first time each round an enemy hits Jory, he counterattacks it.

basic.name: Returning Shot
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy; if it attacked an ally since Maera’s last turn, deals additional damage.

active.name: Keep the Beacon
active.description: Strikes the enemy that most recently damaged an ally. On defeat, allies recover a share of their Max HP.

passive1.name: Watch the Water
passive1.description: The first time each ally falls to low HP, Maera’s next attack is a guaranteed Critical.

passives.name: Keep the Beacon
passives.description: The relief on Keep the Beacon only: an enemy defeated during that cast sends every ally a share of their Max HP.

basic.name: Waking Touch
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally.

active.name: Unfinished Rest
active.description: Strikes every enemy and gives the two lowest-HP allies Recovery. Recovery heals a share of Max HP each turn.

passive1.name: Do Not Disturb
passive1.description: When an ally with Recovery would die, remove Recovery and leave them barely standing. Once per battle.

basic.name: Recorded Shot
basic.description: Deals 330% Attack damage and applies Accounted for 2 rounds. Pinoy also has attacks against an Accounted body unable to miss; nothing in the engine negates a miss chance, so that half is carried in the text only. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 31.

active.name: Evidence Kept
active.description: Strikes an Accounted enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally for a share of their Max HP.

passive1.name: Nothing Forgotten
passive1.description: When an Accounted enemy is defeated, Brio writes Accounted onto the highest-HP enemy.

basic.name: Mending Prick
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally.

active.name: Hold the Seam
active.description: Strikes every enemy and gives the lowest-HP ally Stitching. Stitching heals a share of its holder's Max HP at turn end.

passive1.name: Tighten the Thread
passive1.description: When Stitching runs its course, its holder gains Energy.

basic.name: Garrison Guard
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives the lowest-HP ally Coverguard. Coverguard reduces the next hit.

active.name: Reserve Shelter
active.description: Strikes every enemy and gives every ally Coverguard.

passive1.name: Relief After Loss
passive1.description: When Coverguard is consumed, its holder heals a share of their Max HP.

basic.name: Patch Round
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives a random ally Patchwork. Patchwork raises their Defense.

active.name: Keep It Running
active.description: Strikes every enemy and puts every Patchwork back to its full length.

passive1.name: Borrowed Time
passive1.description: When a blow would kill an ally carrying Patchwork, Patchwork goes instead and the ally is left barely standing. Once per battle.

basic.name: Frame Strike
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives Garron Block Up.

passive1.name: Set Iron
passive1.description: When Garron blocks an attack, he heals a share of his Max HP.

basic.name: Roadside Care
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally.

passive1.name: Carry On
passive1.description: The first time an ally is still at low HP after being healed, they gain Bulwark.

basic.name: Mended Shot
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives a random ally Guard Up.

passive1.name: Useful Again
passive1.description: When an ally carrying Wynn's Guard Up is hit, that ally gains Energy.

basic.name: Cache Shovel
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and recovers a share of Hal's Max HP.

basic.name: Tokenkeeper's Tap
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally.

basic.name: Press Forward
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and delays it, banking the lost turn progress as Turn Debt, up to a limit. An enemy repays Turn Debt in Energy at the start of its turn. If Aeron holds Resolve, he spends all of it on an extra blow that grows with each stack.

active.name: Break the Rhythm
active.description: Strikes every enemy and delays the enemy with the highest Energy, banking the lost turn progress as Turn Debt, up to a limit.

passive.name: Never Yield the Pace
passive.description: Aeron fights the whole battle with Quickened and Block Up.

passive1.name: Never Yield the Pace
passive1.description: When an enemy repays Turn Debt, Aeron gains Resolve, up to a limit. Press Forward spends it.

passive2.name: Momentum Breaker
passive2.description: When an enemy carrying Turn Debt gains enough Energy to use its active skill, Aeron calls in the whole debt: the enemy is delayed and the lowest-Energy ally gains the Energy it owed. Once per enemy each battle.

talentI.name: Interest Owed
talentI.description: An enemy that repays Turn Debt pays interest with it: it is Mired, and Aeron's blows land harder on it.

talentII.name: Shared Tempo
talentII.description: When Momentum Breaker calls in a debt, the lowest-Energy ally also advances its turn, and the enemy that owed is left open to Aeron.

talentIII.name: Unpaid Action
talentIII.description: The first enemy each round to repay a heavy Turn Debt is Silenced once its turn ends, and Aeron's blows land harder on it while it recovers.

basic.name: Offbeat Chime
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest Energy and reduces that enemy's Energy. If the target has more Energy than Dahlia, the lowest-HP ally is healed.

active.name: Scattered Choir
active.description: Strikes every enemy and creates a Displaced state on the enemy with the highest Energy. Displaced enemies cannot target the same ally twice in a row. Whenever a Displaced enemy attacks an ally, that ally gains Energy and Dahlia heals them. If the Displaced enemy uses an Active Skill while Displaced, cancel the skill and remove Displaced.

passive.name: Keep Them Moving
passive.description: Dahlia fights the whole battle with Quickened and Effect Hit Up.

passive1.name: Keep Them Moving
passive1.description: Whenever an enemy loses Energy because of Dahlia, she gains Tempo, up to a limit.

passive2.name: Keep Them Moving
passive2.description: At full Tempo, Dahlia's next basic attack spends all of it and also heals the lowest-HP ally.

passive1.name: Broken Rhythm
passive1.description: The first time each round a Displaced enemy changes its attack target, Dahlia gains Energy and the targeted ally gains a Ward worth a share of Dahlia's Max HP.

passive2.name: Broken Rhythm
passive2.description: When a Displaced enemy tries to use an active skill, Dahlia strikes it first and heals the lowest-HP ally.

passives.name: Scattered Choir
passives.description: Whenever a Displaced enemy damages an ally, that ally gains Energy and Dahlia heals them.

passives.name: Scattered Choir
passives.description: Whenever a Displaced enemy damages Dahlia, she gains Energy and heals herself.

passives.name: Scattered Choir
passives.description: When a Displaced enemy tries to use an active skill, the skill is cancelled and Displaced is removed.

talentI.name: Restless Chorus
talentI.description: Displaced lasts longer. The first time a Displaced enemy changes its attack target each round, that enemy also loses Energy.

talentII.name: Shared Rhythm
talentII.description: Whenever Dahlia heals an ally through Broken Rhythm, the ally with the second-lowest HP is also healed.

talentIII.name: Final Cadence
talentIII.description: When Displaced ends without the enemy having its Active Skill canceled, Dahlia strikes that enemy and immediately restores Energy to the ally with the lowest Energy.

basic.name: Interjecting Clause
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest Energy and applies Anticipated. If Merek has a delay on record, the blow spends it for extra damage that grows with the turn progress he last took, up to a limit.

active.name: Stolen Interval
active.description: Strikes every enemy, then swaps the turn order of the enemy closest to acting and the enemy furthest from acting. The enemy moved back gains Skill Damage Down.

passive.name: Unsettled Timing
passive.description: Merek fights the whole battle with Attack Up, Effect Hit Up and Skill Damage Up.

passive1.name: Interjecting Clause (Anticipated)
passive1.description: When an Anticipated enemy finishes using an active skill, it is delayed.

passive2.name: Priority Inversion
passive2.description: At the start of each round, Merek names the fastest enemy First Claim for that round.

passive1.name: Priority Inversion
passive1.description: The first time each round First Claim uses an active skill, Merek advances the lowest-Energy ally's turn.

passive2.name: Unsettled Timing
passive2.description: The first time each round Merek delays an enemy, he puts it on record for his next basic attack.

talentI.name: Borrowed Minute
talentI.description: When Anticipated delays an enemy, Merek gains Energy, that enemy is delayed further, and his blows land harder on it.

talentII.name: Overturned Agenda
talentII.description: Stolen Interval breaks every enemy's guard before it strikes, and the enemy moved forward keeps it broken longer.

talentIII.name: No First Move
talentIII.description: At the start of each round every enemy loses Energy, and the one nearest to acting is left open to Merek.

basic.name: Unfinished Note
basic.description: Strikes the fastest enemy, or the enemy with the lowest Energy if Oris has just delayed an enemy. If the target is faster than Oris, he strikes it again and takes Energy off it. After Improvise the Way, No Fixed Refrain takes the place of his next two basic attacks.

active.name: Improvise the Way
active.description: Strikes every enemy and applies Disrupted. The first time each round a Disrupted enemy would gain Energy, it loses Energy instead, its turn is delayed and Oris's next ally advances. Oris then begins No Fixed Refrain.

passive.name: Restless Hands
passive.description: Oris fights the whole battle with Quickened, Effect Hit Up and Skill Damage Up.

passive1.name: Restless Hands
passive1.description: When Oris delays an enemy, his next basic attack turns on the enemy with the lowest Energy instead of the fastest.

passive2.name: No Fixed Refrain
passive2.description: After Improvise the Way, Oris's next basic attack is replaced: it strikes the enemy with the highest Energy and takes Energy off it. The one after strikes the enemy with the lowest Energy and advances his turn. An unfinished sequence lapses.

talentI.name: Quicker Fingering
talentI.description: The altered strikes of No Fixed Refrain hit harder, and the second one advances Oris's turn further.

talentII.name: Change the Key
talentII.description: Improvise the Way also takes more Energy off every enemy close to a full bar, and Oris gains Energy if his own bar is low.

talentIII.name: Open Ending
talentIII.description: Once a round, Oris's basic attack runs on one beat longer: he strikes the same enemy again and takes Energy off it.

basic.name: Quiet Dose
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Residue, a Cinder that also records whether the enemy last used a basic attack or an active skill.

active.name: Counterargument
active.description: Strikes an enemy with Residue. If it used the same kind of action on each of its last two turns, Zella consumes the Residue for additional damage and Silences it.

passive.name: Reaction Study
passive.description: Zella fights the whole battle with Attack Up and Effect Hit Up.

passive1.name: Reaction Study
passive1.description: When Residue ticks on an enemy that has changed its kind of action, that enemy loses Energy and Residue is extended. Once per enemy each battle.

passive2.name: Nothing Stays Settled
passive2.description: When an enemy carrying Residue is defeated, its Residue moves to the highest-HP enemy. Moved Residue cannot be extended.

talentI.name: Measured Reply
talentI.description: Quiet Dose leaves an enemy that used the same kind of action on its last two turns easier to affect, and Zella's own blows land harder on it.

talentII.name: Forced Conclusion
talentII.description: Counterargument breaks the guard of an enemy that repeated itself before it strikes, and the Silence it lands lasts longer.

talentIII.name: Settled Testimony
talentIII.description: When Residue ticks on an enemy that has kept to the same kind of action, Zella reads it: she strikes more surely and her critical blows hit harder.

basic.name: Shove Aside
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and shoves it out of position if another enemy is alive.

active.name: Redeploy Cover
active.description: Strikes every enemy and grants all allies Mobile Cover; it reduces the first area hit each round.

passive1.name: Leave No Corner
passive1.description: The first time each round an ally is singled out, that ally's turn advances.

basic.name: Ringing Slug
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Ringing. A Ringing enemy loses Energy whenever it casts an active skill.

active.name: No Quiet Moment
active.description: Strikes every enemy with Ringing, cancels a cast in flight and takes Energy off every Ringing enemy.

passive1.name: Aftershock Clock
passive1.description: At round end, Ringing enemies are delayed.

passives.name: Ringing Slug
passives.description: The toll itself: when any enemy casts, every Ringing enemy loses Energy for it.

basic.name: Bad Entrance
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Flustered, reducing its Effect Hit.

active.name: Take the Floor
active.description: Strikes a Flustered enemy and forces its next attack onto Niko.

passive1.name: Ruin the Agenda
passive1.description: When a Flustered enemy attempts a debuff, Flustered is replaced by Silence. Silence prevents active skills.

basic.name: Cut In
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and advances Sable’s next turn. If Never Waiting is banked, deals additional damage and spends it.

active.name: Wrong Order
active.description: Strikes every enemy and delays the highest-Energy enemy.

passive1.name: Never Waiting
passive1.description: Whenever Sable delays an enemy, she gains Energy and banks extra damage onto her next Basic Attack.

basic.name: Snag
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and takes turn progress off it for each buff it carries, up to a limit.

active.name: Pull the Seam
active.description: Strikes every enemy. Targets close to their next turn are delayed and take more Skill Damage.

passive1.name: Unraveling Order
passive1.description: The first enemy delayed each round gains Guard Down.

basic.name: Offbeat Note
basic.description: Deals 380% Attack damage and applies Disrupted for 2 rounds. A Disrupted enemy loses 8 Energy the first time each round it would gain any. Pinoy has the toll land after the enemy casts an active skill; the engine's Disrupted intercepts an Energy gain instead, and the shape that answers a cast needs a second passive a 3-star does not carry. Draft, Pinoy to confirm.

active.name: Break the Measure
active.description: Deals 520% Attack damage to all Disrupted enemies and delays each by 15% turn progress. Pinoy gives the delay a 50% chance; EffectDef.Chance is read at the ApplyStatus landing roll and nowhere else, so the delay is certain. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 15.

passive1.name: Encore Denied
passive1.description: The first enemy delayed each round takes more damage until its next turn.

basic.name: Platform Change
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and advances Lydia's next turn.

active.name: Miss the Train
active.description: Strikes every enemy and delays the slowest enemy.

passive1.name: No Fixed Departure
passive1.description: At the start of each of her turns Lydia gains 10% Damage Reduction until her next turn. Pinoy gates it on her acting before the slowest enemy; a condition can compare the caster against the body an effect LANDS on and against nobody else, and this one lands on Lydia. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 6.

basic.name: Unexpected Entry
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Off Balance. Off Balance lowers its Effect Resist.

active.name: Through the Service Door
active.description: Strikes an Off Balance enemy and takes a buff off it.

passive1.name: Leave Before Asked
passive1.description: After Roan defeats an Off Balance enemy, Roan cannot be targeted until his next turn.

basic.name: Prybar
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and takes turn progress off it.

active.name: Force the Exit
active.description: Strikes the front enemy, applies Provoke to it and slows it with Mire.

passive1.name: Keep Moving
passive1.description: When an enemy in Mire hits Tomas, he gains a Ward worth a share of his Max HP.

basic.name: Rattle Shot
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and puts its turn back.

passive1.name: Loose Spring
passive1.description: When Jax puts an enemy's turn back, he gains Quickened.

basic.name: Skip Ahead
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and advances Kora's next turn.

passive1.name: First Opening
passive1.description: Kora's strike deals 38% of Attack in additional damage to an enemy that has not acted this round. Pinoy writes it as 10% more damage; the engine's damage modifiers are counted off a status the target carries, and there is none that reads a condition, so the tenth is authored as a second blow. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 35.

basic.name: Displaced Arrow
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Mire.

passive1.name: Unfixed Aim
passive1.description: Sena's shot bites 85% of Attack deeper into a slowed enemy. Pinoy writes it as 10% Critical Chance against the slowed; StatusKind has no Critical Chance entry, so the advantage is paid as damage instead. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 13.

basic.name: Latchbreaker
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and gives Bex Quickened.

basic.name: Rolling Shot
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and puts its turn back.

basic.name: Hidden Burden
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Burden, Cyrra's Cinder, if it is not already burning. Then, while it burns, Cyrra heals the lowest-HP ally, gains Veiled Weight, up to a limit, and takes a round off its Cinder.

active.name: Bury the Burden
active.description: Strikes every enemy and applies Burden to each, then removes Burden from the enemy carrying the most. The two lowest-HP allies are healed from what was removed and gain a Ward. With her Veiled Weight full, those allies also store overflow healing and receive it when the store ends.

passive1.name: Silent Weight
passive1.description: Cyrra fights the whole battle with Effect Resist Up and Max HP Up. Each Veiled Weight she holds makes her healing stronger.

passive2.name: Carry the Burden
passive2.description: The first time each round Cyrra heals an ally at low HP while holding Veiled Weight, she spends one to heal that ally again, gain Energy, and take a round off the Cinder on the highest-Attack enemy.

talentI.name: Deeper Silence
talentI.description: Bury the Burden heals the two lowest-HP allies a second time from the Burden it removed, then removes Burden from a second enemy.

talentII.name: Hidden Reserve
talentII.description: Bury the Burden also stores a share of the healing it gives beyond each warded ally's Max HP, and any overflow after it. When that Ward breaks, or the store runs out, the ally is healed with what was stored.

talentIII.name: Final Weight
talentIII.description: Bury the Burden turns more of the removed Burden into healing for the two lowest-HP allies.

basic.name: Hidden Counter
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy. While Darian holds a Ward he stores a Veil Charge, up to a limit, and a full set is spent on his next basic for an extra blow. A blow primed by The Cost of Knowing is spent the same way.

active.name: Bastion of Secrecy
active.description: Strikes every enemy and gives Darian and the lowest-HP ally a Ward worth a share of his Max HP. A share of what Darian's Wards absorb is stored as Hidden Strength, up to a limit, and when it ends it strikes the highest-Attack enemy and heals Darian.

passive.name: Unseen Guard
passive.description: Darian fights the whole battle with Max HP Up and Guard Up.

passive1.name: Unseen Guard
passive1.description: When an ally at low HP gains a Ward from Darian, they gain a Veil Charge, up to a limit. With a full set, their Veil Charges are spent and they gain Guard, which reduces the next hit.

passive2.name: The Cost of Knowing
passive2.description: When Hidden Strength reaches its limit, Darian gains Energy, strikes the highest-Attack enemy and primes his next Hidden Counter for an extra blow.

passive1.name: Both Shields Survived
passive1.description: When a Ward Darian gave runs out without breaking, he counts it, up to a limit.

passive2.name: Shield Discipline
passive2.description: When Darian has counted enough Wards that ran out unbroken, he spends the count and gains Energy.

talentI.name: Deeper Secrecy
talentI.description: Bastion of Secrecy's Wards are larger and last longer, and Hidden Strength holds far more of what they turn away before it breaks.

talentII.name: Shared Burden
talentII.description: When an ally's Ward breaks, Darian empties his Hidden Strength and gives that ally a Ward worth far more than what it held.

talentIII.name: False Opening
talentIII.description: When a Ward Darian gave runs out unbroken he finds an Opening, up to a limit, and his next Hidden Counter spends one for a heavy extra blow.

basic.name: Unwritten Line
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest Attack. If it carries a buff, Mireth marks it and gains Energy.

active.name: Remove From Record
active.description: Strikes every enemy and marks the enemy with the highest Attack.

passive.name: Absence Has Weight
passive.description: Mireth fights the whole battle with Attack Up, Effect Hit Up and Skill Damage Up.

passive1.name: Absence Has Weight
passive1.description: Whenever Mireth removes a status from an enemy she has marked, she gains Absence, up to a limit. Each Absence makes her hit marked enemies harder.

passive2.name: The Missing Page
passive2.description: The first time each round an enemy Mireth has marked gains a buff, she strips it, strikes the enemy and stores a Page, up to a limit. With the Pages full, she spends them all to strike it harder and apply Attack Down.

talentI.name: Deeper Erasure
talentI.description: The Missing Page erases two marks from the page instead of one, and Mireth can carry more Absence for what she takes away.

talentII.name: Blank Space
talentII.description: When The Missing Page spends a full set of Pages, Mireth gains Energy, the marked enemy loses Energy, and the blank it leaves stays open to her.

talentIII.name: No Record Remains
talentIII.description: Once per battle, when The Missing Page fires on a marked enemy at low HP, Mireth strips her Mark from it and strikes it again.

basic.name: Unseen Shot
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest Attack and marks it with Vanishing Mark. If Nysera has a Hidden Arrow ready while in Stealth, she fires it for an extra blow and gains Energy.

active.name: Where I Was Not
active.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest Attack and the enemy with the lowest HP, and Links the two. The next time either attacks Nysera, the blow lands on the other instead, for less damage.

passive.name: Absence
passive.description: Nysera fights the whole battle with Quickened, Focus and Effect Hit Up. Each Absence she holds makes her hit harder.

passive1.name: Vanishing Mark
passive1.description: When an enemy carrying Vanishing Mark attacks Nysera, the Mark is removed, Nysera gains Stealth, and she gains Absence, up to a limit.

passive2.name: Unaccounted For
passive2.description: The first time each round Nysera gains Stealth, she readies a Hidden Arrow for Unseen Shot.

talentI.name: Deeper Absence
talentI.description: Vanishing Mark lasts longer, and when it fires Nysera also strips a buff from the attacker.

talentII.name: False Target
talentII.description: When her Link turns an attack away from Nysera, the enemy it lands on takes extra damage and the attacker loses Energy.

talentIII.name: Last Known Position
talentIII.description: When Vanishing Mark fires, Nysera also gains Armor Break Up. If she defeats an enemy while it lasts, she gains Stealth again.

basic.name: Denied Return
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the lowest HP. If it is at low HP, Velis gains Energy and strikes the lowest-HP enemy again.

active.name: Hollow the Wound
active.description: Strikes the enemy with the lowest HP. If it is badly hurt, it becomes Hollowed: the next heal it receives is partly turned into damage against it instead. Hollowed does this once.

passive.name: No Second Breath
passive.description: Velis fights the whole battle with Attack Up, Quickened and Effect Hit Up.

passive1.name: No Second Breath
passive1.description: Whenever an enemy below half HP is healed, Velis gains Energy, more if it is Hollowed.

passive2.name: What Was Taken
passive2.description: When Velis holds enough Remnants, she spends them to strike the enemy with the lowest HP, and strikes it again if it is at low HP.

passives.name: What Was Taken
passives.description: Whenever Hollowed turns healing into damage, Velis stores a Remnant, up to a limit.

talentI.name: Deeper Wound
talentI.description: Hollowed lasts longer and turns more of the healing into damage.

talentII.name: Starve the Light
talentII.description: Whenever an enemy below half HP is mended, the mending costs it Energy and leaves the wound open to Velis.

talentIII.name: The Cut Stays Open
talentIII.description: Denied Return leaves its mark: every blow Velis lands on the enemy she is cutting makes the next one land harder.

basic.name: Strike the Line
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy, removes a buff from it and applies Effect Hit Down.

active.name: Record Withheld
active.description: Strikes every enemy and applies Unlisted. An Unlisted enemy loses Energy instead of gaining it, once that round.

passive1.name: Missing Precedent
passive1.description: When an Unlisted enemy finishes casting an active skill, one of its buffs is struck from the record.

basic.name: Decoy Round
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies False Lead. The next single target skill aimed at Ruma lands on one of that enemy’s own allies instead, for less damage.

active.name: Everyone Looks Here
active.description: Strikes every enemy and grants Ruma Concealed. A Concealed unit cannot be targeted directly.

passive1.name: Spare Route
passive1.description: Whenever False Lead sends a blow somewhere else, Ruma gains Energy.

basic.name: Lockstep
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Sealed. A Sealed target cannot receive new buffs.

active.name: No Entry
active.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Provoke to it. While Provoke lasts it is Sealed.

passive1.name: Unasked Question
passive1.description: The first time each round a Sealed enemy strikes another ally, Toren gains a Ward worth a share of his Max HP and redirects a share of that hit.

basic.name: Returned Mail
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Withheld. A Withheld body cannot gain new buffs.

active.name: Keep the Secret
active.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Provoke to it; it is also Withheld.

passive1.name: Private Address
passive1.description: When a Withheld enemy strikes an ally, Petra gains 8% Damage Reduction for 1 round. Pinoy writes it on the enemy TARGETING an ally; the window the engine opens is the blow landing, so a strike that misses or is blocked does not reach it. Draft, Pinoy to confirm.

basic.name: Witness Script
basic.description: Deals 120% Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Attack, and 35% more if Altheon has already damaged that enemy this round. The rider resolves BEFORE the blow it rides, which is what makes its condition a condition: AlreadyDamagedSubjectThisRound reads the round's damage list, and the 120% blow is an entry in that list, so a rider written after it asked a question its own firing had already answered and paid on every basic he ever threw. It was also 42% where Pinoy writes 35%. Ordered this way it fires when something else of his - the Subject's delayed damage, or Fixed in Place - reached that body earlier in the round, which is the sentence the text says. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/PINOY-LIST.md section 2d.

active.name: Immaculate Record
active.description: Deals 185% Attack damage to all enemies and marks the enemy with the highest Attack as the Subject for 3 rounds. The first time the Subject takes damage from Altheon each round, record 30% of that damage, up to 50% of Altheon's Attack. When the Subject expires it takes damage equal to the whole record. Pinoy writes the Subject as 2 rounds and the ceiling as 120% of Attack; at those numbers the ceiling needs a single blow of four times Altheon's Attack and the Subject outruns him, so the record got one blow a round and never closed. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/PINOY-LIST.md section 2d.

passive.name: Preserved Moment
passive.description: Altheon fights the whole battle with Attack Up, Quickened and Skill Damage Up.

passive1.name: Preserved Moment
passive1.description: After each of his basic attacks, Altheon gains a Record, up to a limit, for the rest of the battle. Each Record he holds makes his damage against enemies he has marked hit harder.

passive2.name: Fixed in Place
passive2.description: When the Subject's record reaches its cap, Altheon strikes it, gains Energy and notes its current HP.

talentI.name: Deeper Record
talentI.description: Immaculate Record records a larger share of each blow the Subject takes from Altheon.

talentII.name: Secondary Record
talentII.description: When the Subject's record expires, Altheon also strikes the enemy with the lowest HP for a large share of what the record paid out.

talentIII.name: Final Record
talentIII.description: Once per battle, when the Subject's record reaches its cap, Altheon strikes it again, harder for each Record he holds, then spends every Record.

basic.name: Marked Diagnosis
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest Attack, marks it and heals the lowest-HP ally. If the marked enemy is at low HP, that ally is healed a second time.

active.name: Restore the Balance
active.description: Strikes every enemy and gives the lowest-HP ally Priority. Once each round, a share of the healing that ally receives is stored instead. When Priority ends, the stored healing is released to them at once.

passive.name: No Wasted Recovery
passive.description: Once per battle, when an ally holding Priority falls to low HP, the healing Priority has stored on them is released at once and Priority is removed. Aminah then strikes the enemy with the highest Attack for a share of what was released.

passive1.name: No Wasted Recovery
passive1.description: When a Priority Aminah gave an ally ends, she strikes the enemy with the highest Attack for a share of the healing it released.

passive2.name: Precise Care
passive2.description: Aminah fights the whole battle with Max HP Up and Quickened, and each Measure she holds makes her healing stronger.

passive1.name: Precise Care
passive1.description: When Aminah heals an ally who is at low HP, she gains a Measure, up to a limit, for the rest of the battle.

talentI.name: Defined Priority
talentI.description: Priority stores a far larger share of the healing, and the blow Aminah lands when it releases is much heavier for it.

talentII.name: Shared Measure
talentII.description: Restore the Balance mends the ally with the second-lowest HP as well, and whenever No Wasted Recovery releases stored healing that ally is healed again for a share of what was released.

talentIII.name: Perfect Timing
talentIII.description: When a Priority Aminah gave an ally ends, that ally is healed again - more for each Measure she is holding - and cleansed of what was on them. Every Measure is spent.

basic.name: Find the Measure
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest HP and applies Measured. If it was already Measured, the blow adds damage drawn from its Max HP, up to a limit.

active.name: Define the Weak Point
active.description: Applies True Measure to the enemy with the highest HP and strikes it, adding damage drawn from its Max HP, up to a limit. If it is also Measured, it takes a second helping of the same.

passive.name: Exact Calculation
passive.description: Arden fights the whole battle with Quickened, Armor Break Up and a standing Resolve that powers Exact Calculation.

passive1.name: Exact Calculation
passive1.description: While Arden holds Resolve, he deals more damage to enemies he has Measured or put under True Measure. After his basic attack, a Measured target at high HP takes extra damage drawn from its Max HP, and a True Measure target takes more, each up to a limit.

passive2.name: Everything Has a Limit
passive2.description: After Arden's basic attack on an enemy under True Measure, he records a share of its current HP.

talentI.name: Deeper Measure
talentI.description: Measured lasts longer, and Find the Measure's bonus damage draws a larger share of the target's Max HP, up to a higher limit.

talentII.name: Perfect Line
talentII.description: Once each round, Arden's main blow from Find the Measure or Define the Weak Point ignores part of a True Measure target's Defense. After his basic attack, if the target is under True Measure and at high HP, he gains Energy.

talentIII.name: Final Calculation
talentIII.description: Once per battle, when a True Measure Arden applied expires, the target takes additional damage drawn from the highest value he recorded on it, up to a limit.

passives.name: Everything Has a Limit
passives.description: After Define the Weak Point, Arden records a share of the current HP of the enemy under his True Measure.

passives.name: Everything Has a Limit
passives.description: When a True Measure Arden applied expires, if the target stands above the lowest value he recorded, it takes damage equal to the difference, up to a limit.

basic.name: Answer the Blade
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy. If it is Caldus's Declared Target, he gains Energy.

active.name: Declare the Threat
active.description: Strikes every enemy and names the enemy with the highest Attack as Caldus's Declared Target.

passive.name: Defined Duty
passive.description: Caldus fights the whole battle with Max HP Up and Guard Up.

passive1.name: Defined Duty
passive1.description: When his Declared Target damages Caldus, he counterattacks it, once per round. Each Resolve he holds makes the counterattack hit harder, and each counterattack spends one and banks another, up to a limit.

passive2.name: No Uncertain Ground
passive2.description: When his Declared Target damages another ally, Caldus strikes it and gains Energy, and the ally it hit gains a Ward worth a share of Caldus's Max HP.

talentI.name: Absolute Focus
talentI.description: Declare the Threat names its Declared Target for longer, and Defined Duty's counterattack hits harder.

talentII.name: Guardian's Oath
talentII.description: The Ward No Uncertain Ground gives an ally is larger.

talentIII.name: The Verdict Stands
talentIII.description: Caldus banks Resolve on his own turn as well as when he answers a blow, holds more of it, and each one he holds makes his counterattack land far harder.

basic.name: Exposed Vein
basic.description: Strikes the enemy with the lowest HP and applies Cinder.

active.name: Inevitable Decay
active.description: Strikes the enemy with the lowest HP and applies Revelation. While Revelation lasts, its record banks a share of the Cinder damage that enemy takes, and when it expires the enemy takes the whole record as damage.

passive.name: Proof Leaves a Trace
passive.description: Isolde fights the whole battle with Quickened, Effect Hit Up and Holy Damage Up.

passive1.name: Proof Leaves a Trace
passive1.description: Whenever damage over time Isolde applied deals damage, she gains a Trace, up to a limit, for the rest of the battle.

passive2.name: Unfinished Sentence
passive2.description: The first time each round Isolde's damage over time hurts a Revealed enemy, she strikes it. If that enemy is carrying several debuffs, she strikes harder and gains Energy.

talentI.name: Deeper Trace
talentI.description: Exposed Vein's Cinder burns harder. When a Cinder Isolde applied expires, she gains Energy.

talentII.name: Revealed Consequence
talentII.description: When a Revealed enemy is defeated, Revelation and its record move to the enemy with the lowest HP, which also gains Cinder.

talentIII.name: Final Revelation
talentIII.description: When Revelation expires while Isolde holds a full set of Traces, she spends them all to strike the target for a share of what its record paid out, and harder if it is at very low HP.

basic.name: Catalogue Shot
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and assigns Case Number, listing the target for the whole line.

active.name: Close the Case
active.description: Strikes an enemy with Case Number. The more buffs it displays, the harder it lands, up to a limit.

passive1.name: No Unfiled Death
passive1.description: When an enemy with Case Number falls, every ally gains Energy and the highest-Attack enemy is listed in its place.

basic.name: Tested Touch
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and removes a debuff from the lowest-HP ally.

active.name: Name the Wound
active.description: Strikes every enemy and grants all allies Diagnosed. Diagnosed allies receive more healing.

passive1.name: Exact Treatment
passive1.description: When Lio removes a debuff, that ally recovers a share of the HP it is missing and gains Energy.

basic.name: Stamp of Entry
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and applies Registered.

active.name: Hold the Line
active.description: Strikes the front enemy and holds it in place, during which it takes more damage from Nadine.

passive1.name: Proper Place
passive1.description: The first time each round a Registered enemy hides itself, Nadine strikes it and strips the concealment.

basic.name: Case Note
basic.description: Strikes the front enemy and removes a debuff from the lowest-HP ally.

active.name: Prescribe Exactly
active.description: Strikes every enemy and gives all allies Clarified. Clarified allies gain Effect Resist.

passive1.name: Known Condition
passive1.description: When Clara takes a debuff off an ally, that ally gains 12 Energy. Pinoy pays only for a CONTROL debuff; no field and no condition carries the kind a removal took, so every debuff pays. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 18.
